items.label: Rocket Launcher for Kids
items.value: This rocket launcher set includes 4 dino rockets, 3 Launch Stand Legs, 2 Fixed Ring, 1 step pad, 1 Launch Hose, 1 Fabric Volcano Skirt, 1 launch stand with an adjustable launch tube. Kids can have hours of fun just by running, jumping and stepping

items.label: Soar Up to 100 Ft
items.value: The Rocket Launcher for Kids outdoor toy can soar up to 100 feet height, The height of the flight depends on how hard you step on it and the correct assembly method. Detailed instructions are included. Kids will burn up all their energy and get hours of jumping and steppin fun. Perfect for having a blast in the yard, park or playground

items.label: Easy to Assemble and Storage
items.value: Our Dino Rocket Launcher for Kids is easy to assemble. Parents and children can build it perfectly in just minutes. Learn about hands-On ability and exercise their bodies through play, adjusting launcher tube angles and jumping force to control flight trajectories

items.label: Durable and Soft Material
items.value: The dinosaur toys rocket launcher is made with foam and plastic. Sturdy plastic makes the launcher stand durable. Foam dino rockets are safe for kids. No need for batteries, assemble it and have fun. Perfect for holiday gifts. Great toys for 3 4 5 6 7 year old boys girls

items.label: Purchase Tips
items.value: We recommend that you read the instructions carefully before use. If you have any questions or are missing parts, please contact us. we will respond the first time
